					DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
					COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM
					action_annotation_d
				WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND policy_source_type=1

					AND adherence_type = 0
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
				GROUP BY truncated_time
				),
			combined_hin

t_sent AS (
				SELECT
					truncated_time,
					-- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
					MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
				FROM
					hint_sent
				GROUP BY truncated_time
			),
			-- hint_followed_count
			hint_followed AS(
				-- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
				SELECT
					DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
					COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count
				FROM
					moment_annotation_d
				
				
				WHERE
					adherence_type = 2
					AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversati

on_source IS NULL)
					AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
					
				GROUP BY truncated_time
				UNION ALL
				-- GW|KB hint followed
				SELECT
					DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
					COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				
				
				WHERE
					event_type = 9
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND action_policy_source_type=1
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Addition

al filters
					
				GROUP BY truncated_time
			)
			SELECT
				truncated_time,
				-- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
				SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
			FROM
				combined_hint_sent
				LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time)
			GROUP BY truncated_time
			"}

				GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
				UNION ALL
				-- non-behavior hint.
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
policy_id,

					COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM
					action_annotation_d
				WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND policy_source_type=1
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND adherence_type = 0
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (

conversation_start_time < ?) AND (policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
				GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
				),
			combined_hint_sent AS (
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
policy_id,
					-- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
					MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
				FROM
					hint_sent
				GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
			),
			-- hint_followed_count
			hint_followed AS(
				-- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
policy_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count
				FROM
					moment_annotation_d
				
				
				WHERE

adherence_type = 2
					AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
					AND is_dev_user = 0

					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
					
				GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
				UNION ALL
				-- GW|KB hint followed
				SELECT
					agent_user_id,
action_policy_id AS policy_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				
				
				WHERE
					event_type = 9
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND action_policy_source_type=1
					A

ND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
					
				GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
			)
			SELECT
				agent_user_id,
policy_id,
				-- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
				SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
			FROM
				combined_hint_sent
				LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (agent_user_id, policy_id)
			GROUP BY agent_user_id, policy_id
			"}

				SELECT

agent_user_id,

					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM

					WHERE adherence_type IN (2, 3)
						AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''

< ?))
				)
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND policy_source_type = 1
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
				GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
				UNION ALL
				-- non-behavior hint.
				SELECT
					DATE_TRUNC('week', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(-10)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(-10) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
					COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count
				FROM
					action_annotation_d
				WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: K

B hint
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND policy_source_type=1
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND adherence_type = 0
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
				GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
				),
			combined_hint_sent AS (
				SELECT
					truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
					-- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
					MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
					MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
				FROM
					hint_sent
				GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
			),
			-- hint_followed_count
			hint_followed AS(

-- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
				SELECT
					DATE_TRUNC('week', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(-10)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(-10) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count
				FROM
					moment_annotation_d
				
				
				WHERE
					adherence_type = 2
					AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
					
				GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id

UNION ALL
				-- GW|KB hint followed
				SELECT
					DATE_TRUNC('week', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(-10)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(-10) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
					COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				
				
				WHERE
					event_type = 9
					AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
					AND action_policy_source_type=1
					AND is_dev_user = 0
					AND agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_policy_id IN (?)) AND (conversation_duration_secs >= ?) AND (conversation_duration_secs < ?)) -- Additional filters
					
				GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
			)
			SELECT
				truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
				-- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combines behavio

ral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
				MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
				SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
			FROM
				combined_hint_sent
				LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time, agent_user_id)
			GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
			"}
